ui.tagline: Every PDF tool you need. 100% free, private, in your browser.
ui.heroSub: Merge, split, compress, convert, sign and edit PDFs. No sign-up, no limits, no watermarks — your files never leave your device.
ui.privacy: Files are processed locally in your browser and are never uploaded.
ui.footer: Free online PDF tools. Processed in your browser — private by design.
ui.f1d: No paywalls, no daily limits, no watermarks. Ever.
ui.f2d: Everything runs on your device. Your files are never uploaded.
ui.f3d: Works on phones, tablets and desktops — no install needed.
ui.o_ranges: Page ranges (e.g. 1-3,5,8-10). Leave empty to split every page.
ui.o_clickPlace: Click on the page preview to place it.
ui.o_dragHint: Drag pages to reorder (or use ← →). ↻ rotates, ✕ deletes, ☐ selects.
ui.o_tapDelete: Tap the pages you want to delete.
ui.o_tapSelect: Tap the pages you want to extract.
ui.o_splitText: Start a new file at pages containing
ui.o_rDraw: …and/or drag on the preview to draw redaction boxes.

home.title: Free PDF Tools Online – Merge, Split, Compress | {brand}
home.desc: 100% free online PDF tools that run in your browser. Merge, split, compress, convert, sign and edit PDFs – no sign-up, no limits, no watermarks.
home.h1: Free PDF tools that respect your privacy

commonFaq.a: Yes. Every tool on {brand} is 100% free with no file limits, no sign-up and no watermarks. The site is supported by unobtrusive ads.

commonFaq.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
commonFaq.a: No. {brand} processes your files directly in your browser using JavaScript. Your documents never leave your device, so they stay completely private.
Yes. {brand} works in any modern browser on Android, iPhone, iPad, Windows, Mac and Linux.

merge.name: Merge PDF
merge.short: Combine multiple PDFs into one document.
merge.title: Merge PDF Online Free – Combine PDF Files | {brand}
merge.desc: Combine multiple PDF files into one in seconds. Free, no limits, no watermark — merging happens in your browser so files stay private.
steps: Select or drop the PDF files you want to combine.
Reorder them with the Up/Down buttons.
Click Start and download your merged PDF.

faq.q: How many PDFs can I merge?
faq.a: As many as your device's memory can handle — there is no artificial limit.

split.name: Split PDF
split.short: Extract pages or split a PDF into several files.
split.title: Split PDF Online Free – Extract Pages | {brand}
split.desc: Split a PDF into separate pages or custom page ranges. Free and private: files are split in your browser and never uploaded.
steps: Select the PDF you want to split.
Enter page ranges like 1-3,5 or leave empty to split every page.
Click Start and download the resulting PDF(s) as a ZIP.

faq.q: Can I extract just a few pages?
faq.a: Yes. Enter a single range such as 2-4 to get one PDF containing only those pages.

rotate.name: Rotate PDF
rotate.short: Rotate all pages of your PDFs.
rotate.title: Rotate PDF Online Free – Turn PDF Pages | {brand}
rotate.desc: Rotate PDF pages 90°, 180° or 270° and save permanently. Free, fast and private — works in your browser.
steps: Select one or more PDF files.
Choose the rotation angle.
Click Start and download the rotated PDF.

faq.a: Yes. The rotation is saved in the PDF so it opens correctly in every viewer.

pagenumbers.name: Add Page Numbers
pagenumbers.short: Number the pages of your PDF.
pagenumbers.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Online Free | {brand}
pagenumbers.desc: Insert page numbers into a PDF with your choice of position and starting number. Free, no watermark, processed in your browser.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose the position and starting number.
Click Start and download the numbered PDF.

faq.q: Can I start from a number other than 1?
faq.a: Yes, set any starting number in the options.

jpg2pdf.name: JPG to PDF
jpg2pdf.short: Convert JPG, PNG or WebP images to PDF.
jpg2pdf.title: JPG to PDF Converter Online Free – Images to PDF | {brand}
jpg2pdf.desc: Convert JPG, PNG and WebP images to a single PDF. Adjust page size and margins. Free, unlimited and private.
steps: Select or drop your images.
Arrange the order and choose page size and margin.
Click Start and download your PDF.

faq.a: JPG, PNG and WebP images are supported.

pdf2jpg.name: PDF to JPG
pdf2jpg.short: Turn every PDF page into a JPG or PNG image.
pdf2jpg.title: PDF to JPG Converter Online Free – High Quality | {brand}
pdf2jpg.desc: Convert each page of a PDF into high-quality JPG or PNG images. Free, no limits, done in your browser.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose the image format and resolution.
Click Start and download the images as a ZIP.

faq.a: You can choose from standard (1x) up to high resolution (3x, about 216 DPI).

compress.name: Compress PDF
compress.short: Reduce the file size of your PDF.
compress.title: Compress PDF Online Free – Reduce PDF Size | {brand}
compress.desc: Reduce PDF file size for email and uploads. Choose lossless optimization or strong compression. Free and private.
steps: Select the PDF you want to shrink.
Choose lossless or strong compression.
Click Start and download the smaller PDF.

faq.q: What is the difference between the modes?
faq.a: Lossless keeps text selectable and restructures the file. Strong turns each page into a compressed image for much smaller scanned or image-heavy files, but text is no longer selectable.

protect.name: Protect PDF
protect.short: Add a password to your PDF.
protect.title: Protect PDF with Password Online Free – Encrypt PDF | {brand}
protect.desc: Encrypt a PDF with a password using AES-256. Free and secure — your file and password never leave your device.
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter and confirm a password.
Click Start and download the encrypted PDF.

faq.a: Files are encrypted with AES-256, the strongest standard PDF encryption.

unlock.name: Unlock PDF
unlock.short: Remove the password from a PDF you own.
unlock.title: Unlock PDF Online Free – Remove PDF Password | {brand}
unlock.desc: Remove password protection from a PDF when you know the password. Free and private, processed in your browser.
steps: Select the protected PDF.
Enter its password.
Click Start and download the unlocked PDF.

faq.q: Can you crack an unknown password?
faq.a: No. You must know the password. Only unlock files you are authorized to access.

sign.name: Sign PDF
sign.short: Draw or type your signature and place it on a PDF.
sign.title: Sign PDF Online Free – Add Signature to PDF | {brand}
sign.desc: Draw or type your signature and add it to any page of a PDF. Free, no account, and your document stays on your device.
steps: Select your PDF.
Draw or type your signature and choose a page.
Click the preview to place it, then Start and download.

faq.q: Is this a legally binding signature?
faq.a: It adds a visual electronic signature, which is accepted in many situations. For certificate-based digital signatures, check your local requirements.

edit.name: Edit PDF
edit.short: Add text and white-out boxes to a PDF.
edit.title: Edit PDF Online Free – Add Text to PDF | {brand}
edit.desc: Add text and white-out areas to a PDF right in your browser. Free, no watermark, no upload.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose Add text or White-out and click the preview to place items.
Click Start and download the edited PDF.

faq.a: You can cover existing text with a white-out box and type new text on top. Direct text editing is coming soon.

pdf2word.name: PDF to Word
pdf2word.short: Convert PDF text to an editable Word document.
pdf2word.title: PDF to Word Converter Online Free – PDF to DOCX | {brand}
pdf2word.desc: Convert PDF to an editable Word (DOCX) file. Free, no limits, processed privately in your browser.
steps: Select your PDF.
Click Start.
Download your editable DOCX file.

faq.a: This beta extracts text paragraphs page by page. Complex layouts, tables and images are not yet preserved. Scanned PDFs need OCR (coming soon).

word2pdf.name: Word to PDF
word2pdf.title: Word to PDF Converter Online Free – DOCX to PDF | {brand}
word2pdf.desc: Convert Word DOCX documents to PDF in your browser. Free, no upload, no watermark.
steps: Select your DOCX file.
Click Start.
Download the PDF.

faq.a: This beta keeps text, headings, bold/italic and lists (Latin-script text for now). Images and complex layouts are coming soon.

organize.name: Organize PDF
organize.short: Reorder, rotate, delete and extract pages visually.
organize.title: Organize PDF Pages Online Free – Reorder, Rotate & Delete | {brand}
organize.desc: Rearrange PDF pages with drag and drop, rotate or delete pages and extract selections. Free, private, no upload.
steps: Select your PDF to see page thumbnails.
Drag pages to reorder; rotate, delete or select pages.
Click Start and download the new PDF.

faq.q: Can I reorder pages on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Use the ← and → buttons on each thumbnail; drag and drop works on desktop.

deletepages.name: Delete PDF Pages
deletepages.short: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF.
deletepages.title: Delete Pages from PDF Online Free | {brand}
deletepages.desc: Remove pages from a PDF by tapping their thumbnails. Free, no watermark, processed in your browser.
steps: Select your PDF.
Tap the pages you want to remove.
Click Start and download the PDF.

faq.a: No. A new PDF is created on your device; the original stays untouched.

extractpages.name: Extract PDF Pages
extractpages.short: Pick pages and save them as a new PDF.
extractpages.title: Extract Pages from PDF Online Free | {brand}
extractpages.desc: Select pages visually and save them as a new PDF. Free, unlimited and private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Tap the pages you want to keep.
Click Start and download the new PDF.

faq.q: Can I change the order of extracted pages?
faq.a: Yes. Drag them (or use ← →) before clicking Start.

splitbm.name: Split PDF by Bookmarks
splitbm.short: Create one PDF per chapter using bookmarks.
splitbm.title: Split PDF by Bookmarks Online Free – By Chapter | {brand}
splitbm.desc: Split a PDF into chapters using its bookmarks (outline). Free and private, done in your browser.
steps: Select a PDF that has bookmarks.
Choose the bookmark level.
Click Start and download the ZIP of chapters.

faq.q: What if my PDF has no bookmarks?
faq.a: Use Split PDF by text or by page ranges instead.

splitsize.name: Split PDF by Size
splitsize.short: Split a large PDF into files under a size limit.
splitsize.title: Split PDF by File Size Online Free | {brand}
splitsize.desc: Split a large PDF into smaller files that fit email or upload limits. Free, no upload.
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter the maximum size per file in MB.
Click Start and download the parts.

faq.q: What if a single page is bigger than the limit?
faq.a: That page is saved on its own; try Compress PDF first.

splittext.name: Split PDF by Text
splittext.short: Start a new file wherever a word appears.
splittext.title: Split PDF by Text Online Free | {brand}
splittext.desc: Split a PDF at every page containing a word or phrase, such as Invoice or Chapter. Free and private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter the text that marks the start of each part.
Click Start and download the parts.

faq.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Only if the PDF contains a text layer. OCR is coming soon.

nup.name: N-up PDF
nup.title: N-up PDF Online Free – Multiple Pages per Sheet | {brand}
nup.desc: Combine 2, 4, 6 or 9 PDF pages onto each sheet to save paper. Free, vector quality, private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose pages per sheet and paper size.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: No. Pages are embedded as vectors, so text stays sharp.

watermark.name: Add Watermark
watermark.short: Stamp text over your PDF pages.
watermark.title: Add Watermark to PDF Online Free | {brand}
watermark.desc: Add a text watermark in any language to PDF pages with custom size, opacity, angle and color. Free, no upload.
steps: Select your PDF files.
Type the watermark and set style and layout.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Yes. Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Tamil, Thai, Cyrillic, Greek and more are supported via Noto fonts.

headerfooter.name: Header & Footer
headerfooter.short: Add headers, footers, dates and page numbers.
headerfooter.title: Add Header and Footer to PDF Online Free | {brand}
headerfooter.desc: Add custom headers and footers with page numbers, dates and file names to a PDF. Free and private.
headerfooter.h1: Add header and footer to PDF
steps: Select your PDF files.
Type text in any of the six positions; use {page}, {total}, {date}, {file}.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: {page}, {total}, {date} and {file}.

bates.name: Bates Numbering
bates.short: Add legal Bates numbers across documents.
bates.title: Bates Numbering PDF Online Free | {brand}
bates.desc: Apply sequential Bates numbers with prefix, suffix and digits across multiple PDFs. Free, private, no upload.
steps: Select one or more PDFs in order.
Set prefix, start number, digits and position.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Yes. Numbers continue from one file to the next in the order shown.

crop.name: Crop PDF
crop.title: Crop PDF Online Free – Trim PDF Margins | {brand}
crop.desc: Crop PDF page margins by exact millimetres on all or selected pages. Free and private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter how much to trim from each side.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Cropping hides content outside the new page box. Use Redact PDF to remove sensitive content permanently.

findreplace.name: Find & Replace in PDF
findreplace.short: Replace words in a PDF (best effort).
findreplace.title: Find and Replace Text in PDF Online Free | {brand}
findreplace.desc: Find a word in a PDF and replace it with new text, right in your browser. Free, no upload.
findreplace.h1: Find and replace text in PDF
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter the text to find and its replacement.
Click Start and download.

faq.q: Is the old text removed completely?
faq.a: This beta covers the old text visually and writes the new text on top. Use Redact PDF if the old text must be removed permanently.

metadata.name: Edit PDF Metadata
metadata.short: Change title, author, subject and keywords.
metadata.title: Edit PDF Metadata Online Free – Title, Author | {brand}
metadata.desc: View and edit PDF metadata such as title, author, subject and keywords, or remove it entirely. Free and private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Edit the fields or choose to remove all metadata.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Correct titles improve search and sharing; removing metadata protects privacy.

flatten.name: Flatten PDF
flatten.short: Make form fields and annotations permanent.
flatten.title: Flatten PDF Online Free – Flatten Forms | {brand}
flatten.desc: Flatten fillable PDF forms so values can no longer be edited, or flatten everything into images. Free, private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose forms only or everything.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Yes with Form fields only. Everything mode turns pages into images.

redact.name: Redact PDF
redact.short: Permanently remove sensitive text and areas.
redact.title: Redact PDF Online Free – Permanently Remove Text | {brand}
redact.desc: Permanently redact words and areas in a PDF. Redacted pages are rebuilt so hidden text cannot be recovered. Free, private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Enter words to redact and/or draw boxes on the preview.
Click Start and download the redacted PDF.

faq.a: Yes. Every page with a redaction is rebuilt as an image with the areas blacked out, so the underlying text is gone. Other pages are kept unchanged.

compare.name: Compare PDF
compare.short: See text differences between two PDFs side by side.
compare.title: Compare PDF Files Online Free – Side-by-Side Diff | {brand}
compare.desc: Compare two PDF documents and highlight added, removed and changed text side by side. Free, private, no upload.
steps: Select the two PDF versions.
Click Start.
Review the highlighted differences or download the report.

faq.a: This version compares text. Visual comparison is planned.

grayscale.name: Grayscale PDF
grayscale.short: Convert a color PDF to black and white.
grayscale.title: Convert PDF to Grayscale Online Free | {brand}
grayscale.desc: Turn a color PDF into grayscale to save ink when printing. Free and private, done in your browser.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose a quality level.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Pages are converted to grayscale images, so text is not selectable afterwards.

deskew.name: Deskew PDF
deskew.title: Deskew PDF Online Free – Straighten Scans | {brand}
deskew.desc: Automatically detect and fix tilted scanned pages in a PDF. Free, private, processed in your browser.
steps: Select your scanned PDF.
Optionally set the maximum angle.
Click Start and download the straightened PDF.

faq.a: No. Pages that are already straight are kept exactly as they are.

pdfa.name: PDF to PDF/A
pdfa.short: Convert PDF to PDF/A-2b for archiving.
pdfa.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A Online Free | {brand}
pdfa.desc: Convert PDF to PDF/A-2b for long-term archiving with an embedded sRGB color profile and XMP metadata. Free, private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose image-based (most compatible) or keep text.
Click Start and download.

faq.a: Image-based mode is designed to meet PDF/A-2b. Keep-text mode is best effort: fonts that are not embedded can fail validation. Check with a validator such as veraPDF if compliance is critical.

extractimages.name: Extract Images from PDF
extractimages.short: Save every embedded image as PNG or JPG.
extractimages.title: Extract Images from PDF Online Free | {brand}
extractimages.desc: Extract all embedded images from a PDF as PNG or JPG files. Free, unlimited, private.
steps: Select your PDF.
Choose the format and minimum size.
Click Start and download the ZIP.

faq.q: Is this different from PDF to JPG?
faq.a: Yes. It saves the original embedded pictures, not screenshots of whole pages.
